faqs.a:
(a)
Chair.
The board shall elect from its members a chair of the board.
(b)
Secretary.
The board shall elect from its members a secretary to the board.
(c)
Treasurer.
The finance director shall be ex officio treasurer of the board and the administrative
               officer of the retirement system. Nothing contained in this chapter shall prevent
               the treasurer from serving as secretary of the board. The treasurer shall be bonded
               in an amount to be determined by the board. The cost of the bond shall be paid from
               the police pension fund; provided, however, if the bond of the treasurer required
               by the city is sufficient to meet the board's requirements, no additional bond shall
               be required of the treasurer.
(d)
Legal adviser.
The city attorney shall be legal adviser to the board.
(e)
Terms.
The terms of the respective officers specified in this section shall be as determined
               by the rules and regulations established by the board.
(Code 1960, § 19-2(G); Code 1981, § 26-29)
Charter reference—
Duties of city attorney, § 8.1.
State Law reference—
Similar provisions as to statutory system, C.R.S. § 31-30-618.
